summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature testing for RideReserve follow-up features (config, geocode, reviews, referrals, Razorpay fallback). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py with 15 tests; hardened /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py flake fixes (DB_NAME default, async->sync pymongo promotion, unique seat/date to eliminate re-run collisions). Full suite: 37/37 pass (22 regression + 15 new). Verified: /api/config returns razorpay_enabled=false + referral_bonus=50; /api/geocode returns coords for known cities (Bangalore/Mysore case-insensitive) and 404 for unknown; /api/reviews creates reviews only for owner+paid bookings, blocks duplicates (409), blocks non-paid bookings (400), and recomputes vehicle avg rating; /api/reviews/vehicle/{id} and /api/reviews/mine list correctly; /api/referrals/me returns auto-generated RR-prefixed code + bonus=50; apply-own-code=400, invalid=404, twice=409; referral bonus flow verified end-to-end: A gets +₹50, B gets +₹50 on B's first paid booking, referral_paid flips, 2nd paid booking does NOT double-credit; Razorpay: with blank keys POST /bookings/{id}/pay method='razorpay' falls back to mock and fulfills booking (status=paid); /bookings/verify-payment correctly returns 400 'not configured'; gpay path still works.
action_items: No blockers. Optional: consider using dedicated test DB or per-test cleanup to further isolate tests from seeded/production data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Razorpay branch: when method=='razorpay' but RAZORPAY_ENABLED is False, code silently falls through to mock fulfillment (line 568-585). This matches spec ('graceful fallback') but the client cannot distinguish an intended-real vs fell-back-to-mock payment. Consider returning a flag like {mocked:true} in the response so the app can toast a hint.
/api/referrals/me computes `earned` by regexing transaction notes ('^Referral bonus'). Works today, but coupling to note text is fragile — prefer a dedicated `type: 'referral_bonus'` on transactions.
/api/reviews accepts stars via Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5) — good validation.
Duplicate-review guard uses unique index on booking_id (seed()) AND explicit find_one check → 409 works.
_fulfill_paid_booking is idempotent (returns immediately if already paid) — good, prevents double credit on retries.
referral_paid is set atomically with $inc on same update_one — good.
Verify-payment: signature check uses hmac.compare_digest — correct constant-time compare.
server.py is now 1010 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/vehicles/bookings/wallet/admin/reviews/referrals/geocode) as it continues to grow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (DB_NAME default, sync pymongo promotion, unique seats/dates)

Razorpay keys intentionally blank -> RAZORPAY_ENABLED=false -> method='razorpay' falls back to mock; /api/bookings/verify-payment returns 400. Reviews unique per booking (409 on duplicate); vehicle rating recomputed as running avg on write.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all 4 new features working end-to-end. Prior iteration flakes were purely test-hygiene (hardcoded seats colliding on 2nd run + wrong DB_NAME default + asyncio.get_event_loop deprecation on py3.11). Fixed in test files.
